facts.fact: Thirteen communes already have a 'biometric registration system' within the digital modernisation of the civil registration system, as reported on African civil registration day; no total of communes or offices is given.
The article states that the digitisation rests on the registration of civil-status events in pilot communes, with services decentralised down to zone level.
As of 10 August 2026 thirteen communes had the system and the authorities were progressively extending the digitisation and decentralisation of civil registration services.

systems.tiers: 13 pilot communes; services decentralised to zone level
